subject: Recap: Inference deployment mode & migration options / next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Diana Park <diana.park@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Inference deployment mode & migration options / next steps

Hi Diana —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Call takeaways: 
- Primary goal: move production personalization models (seq lengths ~512, peak concurrent requests ~250/s) off a legacy GPU cluster to reduce ops overhead and improve tail latency.
- Data residency: core PII datasets must remain in us-west for now; EU region may be needed later.
- Current stack: custom Triton-based serving + an internal KV cache layer; some models quantized to 4-bit.
- Key constraints: 99.9% availability desired, typical p95 latency target <120ms for short prompts, procurement window ~8–10 weeks.

Preliminary recommendation (what we discussed):
- Short-term: Redwood Hosted API for a fast PoC and to validate latency/cost on real traffic; gives minimal integration time and we can apply prefix/KV caching to reduce token costs.
- Mid-term: Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and data isolation once SLI targets are validated (maps well to your 250/s burst).
- Long-term/regulated workloads: Private VPC (customer-managed) if you need full network isolation and on-prem controls.

Migration notes we should confirm:
- Are you planning to lift-and-shift existing Triton models or retrain to a Redwood-supported format (PT/ONNX)?
- Any hard-deadline for cutover beyond the procurement timeline?
- Which team owns keys/KMS for telemetry & audit logs during evaluation?

Next steps (action items):
1) We will produce a short, side-by-side comparison doc with latency/cost trade-offs for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (attached).
2) Priya will prepare a rough Dedicated capacity estimate and a sample procurement worksheet (eta: 2 business days).
3) Diana/Marcus to confirm: (a) desired SLA level, (b) whether you want EU residency included in the Dedicated quote.
4) Schedule a 30-min technical session with your infra lead to review migration constraints (we suggested Tue or Wed next week).

Attachments: redwood-deploy-options.pdf (summary), I’ll follow up with an estimate file after Priya’s input.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Diana Park <diana.park@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-15T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Inference deployment mode & migration options / next steps

Thanks Rishi — solid recap. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- We are leaning toward Dedicated for predictable cost and isolation, but need to understand the delta to Private (VPC) for procurement and security sign-off.
- Migration approach: our infra team prefers reusing the Triton pipeline where possible to shorten timeline; they may accept converting specific models to a compatible format rather than a full retrain.
- SLA: we want to see options for 99.9% vs 99.95% (cost delta is important).

Procurement note: Marcus (cc’d) is our procurement lead and will want a line-item estimate. Marcus, can you confirm whether we also need to budget for a temporary hosted-integration phase?

Finally, is there a lightweight test token we can use to validate latency from our office in us-west? That will help us choose between Hosted vs Dedicated for the PoC.

Best,
Diana
Diana Park
Director, Product — Acme Finance

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Diana Park <diana.park@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Inference deployment mode & migration options / next steps

Diana —
Ack, we’ll put together a side-by-side that includes: SLA tiers (99.9/99.95), estimated monthly committed cost for Dedicated at your 250/s peak, and one-off onboarding fees for Private VPC.

Aditya — I’m going to loop you in for the Triton-compatibility questions — can you outline the typical conversion points we see (model format, kv-cache touchpoints, custom ops) and an ETA for a small assessment?

Rishi — I’ll have the Dedicated worksheet and draft estimate to share by EOD Monday.

— Priya
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Inference deployment mode & migration options / next steps

Quick note on the technical side:
- Triton lifts: we commonly take the model artifacts (PT/ONNX) and map them to Redwood’s runtime; custom Triton ops are the main friction. If you have a small representative model we can run a compatibility scan in ~48 hours.
- KV/cache: Redwood supports prefix and KV caching; we’ll need to understand TTLs and cache key design to preserve correctness.
- Quantized models: 4-bit quantization is supported for many families; we’ll check perf regressions against your p95 on the PoC.

I can join the technical session; Tue/Wed next week works for me.

— Aditya
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Diana Park <diana.park@acme.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-16T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Inference deployment mode & migration options / next steps

Thanks all — attaching the migration checklist and a preliminary Dedicated estimate (spreadsheet). Highlights / action items: 

- Migration checklist (attached): sample model compatibility scan, required infra access, sample dataset for latency/cost validation, and a short runbook for fallback to Hosted if any regressions occur.
- Dedicated estimate (attached): two sizing scenarios (baseline 250/s sustained, and 400/s burst-capable). I annotated the SLA-cost delta and included a line for EU region replication.
- PoC token: we can issue a short-lived test token scoped to a single project for latency testing from your us-west office. To request it, reply with the IP subnets you’ll test from and a primary contact.

Proposed calendar: 30-min technical review on Wed 2026-08-19 10:00am PT. Let me know if that works; we’ll add a calendar invite.

Next steps (who/when):
- Acme: confirm SLA choice + IPs for PoC token (Marcus/Diana) — please by Tue EOD.
- Redwood: Priya to send final Dedicated worksheet (Mon EOD), Aditya to run compatibility scan after Acme sends a representative model.

Regards,
Rishi

From: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Diana Park <diana.park@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-08-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Inference deployment mode & migration options / next steps

Thanks — Wed 10am PT works for the tech call.

We’ll get you the IP subnets for the PoC token and a small Triton model (example) by EOD Tue. Procurement is asking for a line-item quote for Dedicated vs Private (include support tiers). Marcus will also need estimated onboarding time for Private (we expect longer lead-time).

Look forward to the call.

— Marcus
